description: Timing review snapshot: observer-page displayed series for the original sample and two additional observed candidates; explicitly filtered single-OID ZTF caches and saved NEOWISE visits for five added literature anchors. Units and extraction per source are recorded. Descriptive histories, not fitted nuclear luminosities or event dates.

targets.name: P1823
targets.spectral_review: High continuum state with broadly similar recent line profiles. Important time-domain target; neither a secure record luminosity nor a demonstrated turn-on.

targets.name: P11530
targets.spectral_review: Strong long-term spectral/color change versus 2019; NGPS resembles the redder 2023-2025 state. Test intrinsic fading against host/aperture effects; no confirmed turn-off.

targets.name: P10381
targets.spectral_review: Broad Hbeta remains present. Hbeta-wing/[OIII] proxy is within about 3-5% of 2014 and 1-3% of 2024 across continuum choices. Possible recovery after published fading; fit the 2018 spectrum before claiming recurrence.

targets.name: P9694
targets.spectral_review: Strongest clean new broad-profile change in our triage: Hbeta-wing/continuum about 37-38% higher and wing/[OIII] about 32-33% higher than 2021. Broad lines already existed; not a confirmed turn-on.

targets.expansion_rationale: Catalogue turn-on anchor with large optical rise to 2021 followed by decline, and a W1 peak in 2022 followed by decline. Extends the range of variability amplitudes and optical/IR timing.
